title: hydrangea macrophylla subsp. angustata
intro: Hydrangea macrophylla subsp. angustata, commonly known as Japanese hydrangea or narrow-leaved bigleaf hydrangea, is a species of flowering plant in the family Hydrangeaceae. This plant is rich in antioxidants and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an anti-cancer agent. The therapeutic actions of Hydrangea macrophylla subsp. angustata include its ability to inhibit the growth of certain cancer cells, reduce blood pressure, and exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
